text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month and nine-month treasury bills were unchanged, yields on six-month bills fell and yields on 12-month bills rose from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Monday.

Three-month bills remained at 24.47 percent, six-month bills slipped to 31.27 percent from 31.30 percent, nine-month bills remained at 34.86 percent, and 12-month bills firmed to 39.93 percent from 39.89 percent.
The results of Monday's three-month discount T-bill auction,
compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 4.30 million UAH 4.00 million UAH
Amount sold 2.05 million UAH 3.02 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.94 million UAH 2.85 million UAH
The central bank sold 20,538 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 15.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared
to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 23.00 million UAH 7.00 million UAH
Amount sold 7.65 million UAH 4.06 million UAH
Actual amount raised 6.62 million UAH 3.51 million UAH
The central bank sold 76,481 T-bills, the bank's statement
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills

compared to the last issue, were as follows:
